excluded.src/cli/**: The mb command line, not the HTTP contract; mbTest's cli suite exercises it (#1547)
excluded.src/controllers/feedController.js: The Atom feed of mb's release notes, a UI page with no Rift counterpart
excluded.src/controllers/homeController.js: mb's HTML home and docs pages, which Rift does not serve
excluded.src/controllers/logsController.js: mb's own log viewer, which Rift does not serve
excluded.src/models/filesystemBackedImpostersRepo: --datadir persistence: the harness starts both engines without it (a second engine-pair configuration is a follow-up)
excluded.src/models/http/index.js: Entry point for running http as an out-of-process --protofile plugin, which Rift does not implement
excluded.src/models/https/index.js: Entry point for running https as an out-of-process --protofile plugin, which Rift does not implement
excluded.src/models/mbConnection.js: The callback channel of out-of-process --protofile protocols, which Rift does not implement
excluded.src/models/protocols.js: The --protofile plugin loader; the built-in http and https protocols it wires are measured in their own files
excluded.src/models/smtp/**: smtp imposters: Rift refuses the protocol (InvalidProtocol)
excluded.src/models/tcp/**: tcp imposters: Rift refuses the protocol (InvalidProtocol)
excluded.src/mountebank.js: Server bootstrap: which branches run depends on mb's own command-line flags (--datadir, --debug, --apikey, --protofile), not on a case; mbTest's cli suite exercises it (#1547)
